newsitem.title: UK: British Land prices 300 mln stg convertible.
newsitem.headline: British Land prices 300 mln stg convertible.

text.p: British Land Co Plc has priced its 300 million stg 10-year convertible bond to pay a coupon of 6.50 percent, the top end of the indicated range.
The conversion price was set at 6.80 stg per share. The par-priced notes will be convertible at a premium of 21.2 percent (20-22 percent indicated) over the mid-price close of 5.61 stg.
SBC Warburg will be lead manager, British Land said.
The issue is callable, in whole or in part, at any time from June 17, 2002 at par plus accrued interest.
The deal may be increased by an additional 30 million stg (10 percent). The London-listed notes are available in denominations of 1,000 stg, 10,000 stg and 100,000 stg.

British Land said the majority of the proceeds of the issue will be used to finance its current acquisition programme, including forward funding of additional office space at No. 1 Finsbury Avenue, London and extensions at a number of food superstores.

The balance will be used to refinance bank indebtedness and for general corporate purposes. There are no new strategic acquisitions of major significance to the group currently in progress, British Land said.
